title: Enforcing Dirichlet Boundary Conditions in Operator Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.27256v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Operator learning in scientific machine learning is concerned with approximation of maps between infinite-dimensional function spaces; such maps frequently arise as the solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). Neural operators have demonstrated broad empirical success at approximating such maps from data. However, most existing neural operator architectures enforce boundary conditions indirectly through training from data even though the boundary condition is often known exactly. Furthermore, existing modifications and approaches that do enforce boundary conditions explicitly suffer from impractical restrictions, including boundary smoothness, uniform grids, and separable, box-like domains. translated_title: 在算子学习中强制实施狄利克雷边界条件
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27256v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：科学机器学习中的算子学习关注于无限维函数空间之间映射的逼近；这类映射常作为偏微分方程（PDEs）的解算子出现。神经算子在从数据逼近这类映射方面已展现出广泛的实证成功。然而，大多数现有神经算子架构通过从数据训练间接地强制边界条件，尽管边界条件通常是精确已知的。此外，现有显式强制边界条件的修改和方法受到不切实际的限制，包括边界光滑性、均匀网格和可分离的盒状域。在本工作中，我们提出了一种架构，该架构独立于训练，满足齐次狄利克雷边界条件，同时保留现有核积分神经算子架构的表达能力。
tldr: 提出了一种新架构，能在无需训练的情况下显式满足齐次狄利克雷边界条件，同时保持核积分神经算子的表达能力，克服了现有方法在边界光滑性和域形状上的限制。
en_tdlr: A new architecture is proposed that explicitly satisfies homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions independent of training, while retaining the expressivity of kernel-integral neural operators and overcoming limitations of existing methods regarding boundary smoothness and domain shape.
